messages.text:
Playwright’s web server shows the default dev loader still hits the TanStack resolver issue.

I’m checking normal `vite preview` with the built output now; if preview binds correctly, the smoke test can target the production build instead of dev.

commands.commandLine: "C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command '$p = Start-Process -FilePath .'"\\node_modules\\.bin\\vite.cmd -ArgumentList @('preview','--host','127.0.0.1','--port','3010') -WorkingDirectory 'T:\\' -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden; Start-Sleep -Seconds 8; Write-Output \"PID="'$($p.Id)"; Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3010 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess'

"C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command 'Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessId -eq 35132 -or $_.ParentProcessId -eq 35132 } | Select-Object ProcessId,CommandLine; Stop-Process -Id 35132 -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue'
